title: Context Mode: cutting Claude Code's context consumption by 98 percent.
description:
if you use Claude Code, you NEED this. You know when you're deep in a session and the AI just… forgets everything? That's context degradation. Context Mode fixes it — cutting Claude Code's context consumption by 98 percent. It intercepts massive tool outputs, chunks them, and only feeds the AI exactly what it needs. Real results: 315 kilobytes shrunk to 5.4 — stretching sessions from 30 minutes to nearly 3 hours. No extra API calls. 

https://github.com/mksglu/claude-context-mode

#github #opensource
